song_craft: Separation-in-nearness song (11v): parted-yet-burning (v1) → parting-pithed-unparted (v2) → all-Thou (v3) → match-only (v4) → held-roaming (v5) → content-alone (v6) → cloud-melting (v7) → middle-jewel (v8, WHERE open) → weary-no-effort (v9, not anti-effort) → will-embrace (v10) → fainting-hunt (v11). HOW/WHERE unexplained per BOUNDARY — mystery kept, not mapped.

lines: Though parted from Thee, Ruler, though it be a mere instant —
I ever thick-burning: may I be ground for Thy glance.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kṣaṇamātram apīśāna viyuktasya tvayā mama | nibiḍaṃ tapyamānasya sadā bhūyā dṛśaḥ padam

verses.craft: Parted-instant yet thick-burning; glance-ground plea; HOW-unexplained per BOUNDARY.

lines: In parting-pithed passing — by Thee, dear Master —
may I be ever unparted, though from the world parted.
l4.sanskrit_cite: viyogasāre saṃsāre priyeṇa prabhuṇā tvayā | aviyuktaḥ sadaiva syāṃ jagatāpi viyojitaḥ

lines: Body, speech, mind — where I go with them, all is Thou alone.
May this highest truth stand full for me, ever.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kāyavāṅmanasair yatra yāmi sarvaṃ tvam eva tat | ity eṣa paramārtho 'pi paripūrṇo 'stu me sadā

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['See C1 BOUNDARY for open questions.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Thought-free as Thou, great-bliss-full as Thou —
so may my praise-making speech match, and only match.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirvikalpo mahānandapūrṇo yadvad bhavāṃs tathā | bhavatstutikarī bhūyād anurūpaiva vāṅ mama

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['See C1 BOUNDARY for open questions.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Held by Thee — seeing thing and thing Thou-made —
may I roam longing-free, joy-brimmed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhavadāveśataḥ paśyan bhāvaṃ bhāvaṃ bhavanmayam | vicareyaṃ nirākāṅkṣaḥ praharṣaparipūritaḥ

lines: Lord, may I see the all-world full of Thy being —
with that alone content. Then — no more wearing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhagavanbhavataḥ pūrṇam paśyeyam akhilaṃ jagat | tāvataivāsmi santuṣṭas tato na parikhidyase

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['See C1 BOUNDARY for open questions.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Melting in Thee alone — like cloud-shreds in sky —
may things shine for me, ever, step by step stainless.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vilīyamānās tvayy eva vyomni meghalavā iva | bhāvā vibhāntu me śaśvat kramanairmalyagāminaḥ

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['See C1 BOUNDARY for open questions.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Self-light outspread, shattering the endless dark-train —
shine for me ever: some jewel of Thy being, from Thy middle.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svaprabhāprasaradhvastāparyantadhvāntasantatiḥ | santataṃ bhātu me ko 'pi bhavamadhyād bhavanmaṇiḥ

verses.craft: Dark-train shattering jewel; middle-placed (WHERE unexplained per BOUNDARY).

lines: What ground rulest Thou not? What could it be, not Thy body? Weary —
thereby, by no-effort, may I win Thee everywhere.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kāṃ bhūmikāṃ nādhiśeṣe kiṃ tat syād yan na te vapuḥ | śrāntas tenāprayāsena sarvatas tvām avāpnuyām

verses.rejected: (a) no-effort→grace → killed: effortlessness stands with burning.

lines: Thy limb-embrace's joy — by my will alone may it befall me.
This much won — what, Lord, have I not won?
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgapariṣvaṅgasambhogaḥ svecchayaiva me | ghaṭatām iyati prāpte kiṃ nātha na jitaṃ mayā

verses.craft: Will-alone limb-joy befalls (Swamiji gloss per note); what-have-I-not-won close.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Swamiji (Academy, ch6 v10): the devotee desires to embrace the Master 'just by my will,' because 'by Thy embrace I have conquered everything.'"]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Show plain! With no other prayers importune we Thee, Lord —
fainting, Thee alone we hunt.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakaṭībhava nānyābhiḥ prārthanābhiḥ kadarthanāḥ | kurmas te nātha tāmyantas tvām eva mṛgayāmahe
